tabs.html:
BDCOM S2900-8T4X: 4-Port 10G + 8-Port Gigabit L3-Lite Managed Switch

High-Performance 10G & Gigabit Network Switch for Enterprises & Data Centers

The BDCOM S2900-8T4X is a high-performance, L3-lite managed switch designed for enterprise networks, cloud computing, and data centers. With 8 Gigabit RJ45 ports and 4 high-speed 10G SFP+ ports, this switch provides seamless, low-latency data transmission, making it an ideal solution for high-bandwidth applications.


With a fanless design and energy-efficient operation, the BDCOM S2900-8T4X ensures silent operation, reducing power consumption while maintaining enterprise-grade performance.


Key Features 

  • 10G High-Speed Networking – Equipped with 4x 10GE SFP+ uplink ports, enabling lightning-fast data transfer for servers, storage, and high-performance computing.
  • 8x Gigabit Ethernet Ports – Provides fast and reliable connections for workstations, access points, and edge devices.
  • L3-Lite Managed Switch – Supports advanced Layer 3 networking features, ensuring efficient traffic management and improved network performance.
  • High Bandwidth Backplane – 128 Gbps switching capacity for seamless data transmission and zero bottlenecks.
  • Wire-Speed Performance – With a 72 Mpps forwarding rate, this switch handles high-density traffic efficiently.
  • Fanless, Silent Operation – Low power consumption (Max 45W) and no moving parts, ensuring reliable and energy-efficient performance.
  • Enterprise-Grade Design – 1U, 19-inch rack-mountable chassis for easy installation in server rooms and data centers.
  • Easy Management – Supports console management (RJ45) for seamless configuration and monitoring.
  • Reliable & Durable – Backed by a 2-Year Warranty for long-term performance and peace of mind.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: BDCOM S2900-8T4X
  • 8x Gigabit RJ45 Ports
  • 4x 10GE SFP+ Uplink Ports
  • Switching Capacity: 128 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 72 Mpps (64-byte packets)
  • Power Supply: Single AC 220V
  • Single AC Power Supply
  • Power Consumption: Max 45W
  • Fan less Design: Silent operation with energy-efficient cooling
  • Form Factor: 1U, Standard 19-inch Rack-Mountable
  • Management Interface: Console (RJ45)
  • Warranty: 2-Year Manufacturer Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise Networks – Ensures seamless connectivity for workstations, VoIP, and surveillance systems.
  • Data Centers & Cloud Computing – Provides high-speed 10G uplinks for storage and server aggregation.
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) – Ideal for low-latency, high-throughput networking.
  • ISP & Hosting Providers – Scalable networking for data-intensive environments.
  • Edge Computing & IoT Deployments – Supports fast data transmission for connected devices.


Why Choose the BDCOM S2900-8T4X?

  • 10G & Gigabit Hybrid Design – Perfect for modern high-bandwidth networks.
  • Layer 3-Lite Management – Ensures advanced network segmentation and security.
  • Silent & Energy-Efficient – Fan less design minimizes power consumption while maximizing performance.
  • Rack-Mountable & Scalable – Compact 1U form factor, easy to deploy in enterprise IT environments.
  • Reliable Performance – Backed by a 2-year warranty, ensuring long-term durability.
